policy: Before first execution: freeze five original fictional JDs and manual truth. Do not rewrite oracles after results. No push/PR before H9 PR opens. V5 unchanged.

independence.current_task: Only specifications, example profiles and our V4 format. No parser source, existing parser tests or executor H9 branch read; no vocabulary lookup to constrain manual skills.
independence.prior_context: M1-6 earlier in this conversation touched parser/tests; V4 used public CLI. No claim of zero historical implementation exposure.

comparison_policy.skills: Body positive requirements only; exclude title-only, negation, company description and footer. Keep original spelling. NFKC/casefold/remove whitespace set comparison; no alias merging.
comparison_policy.cities: Set comparison; expected retains original order.
comparison_policy.other_fields: Scalar/object exact values, graduation years compared as a set.

difference_types.wrong: wrong scalar or missing and extra together
difference_types.policy_blank: Only the two frozen conflicting-duration fields: null is required H9 abstention; not an extraction error and not a truth match.

comparison_policy.duration_rule: Keep manual truth 4. Actual null => policy_blank; actual 3 => wrong. Actual 4 => truth match but separately flag expected H9 null was not followed. Count raw truth match, policy blank, accepted groups and policy compliance separately.
comparison_policy.match: Primary denominator remains 10 verdicts/70 states against manual truth. Report raw parse-to-filter differences, 4 anticipated null-month verdicts/28 states separately, and manual-fields replay. Null month means unknown under current contract; do not treat expected downstream information loss as a matcher bug.
comparison_policy.contract: Current implemented Job Schema/match only, no M2-4 design extensions.
